fix_suggestion.root_cause_analysis: The compilation errors stem from missing 'struct' keyword usage before certain ASN.1 generated types in the C code. In C, when a type is defined as a struct but not typedef'd, the 'struct' keyword is mandatory when declaring variables or pointers of that type. The code attempts to use these types as if they were typedefs, causing the compiler to not recognize them and report unknown type errors. Furthermore, member access errors occur because the variables are not recognized as structs. This is a common issue when ASN.1 generated code is included without proper typedefs or when the code omits the 'struct' keyword. The fix is to add 'struct' before these type names in declarations and ensure the relevant ASN.1 generated headers defining these structs are included in the source file.
